results.scope: storage topology and backup independence, re-verified
results.result: All four roots share device 2128: repository checkout, /home/gus/scientific-closure-runtime, /home/gus/scientific-closure-inputs, /home/gus/scientific-closure-backup. Both Pergamino CSVs are byte-identical between inputs and backup (cmp exit 0). Physical independence NOT achieved.

new_precision_found.observed: The writable Linux root filesystem (/dev/sdf, ext4, device 2128) is backed by the file /mnt/c/Users/gusta/AppData/Local/wsl/{5f70ee9f-c4f5-4a9f-b182-e94458fcd4dc}/ext4.vhdx, which resides on the C: volume. The read-only copy of the source CSVs under /mnt/c (device 217) therefore lives on the same underlying host volume as the primary.
new_precision_found.consequence: Mounting the unmounted /dev/sdd is NOT demonstrated to achieve physical independence, because a WSL block device of that kind is itself typically a VHDX file on the same host volume. This is stated as an INFERENCE about /dev/sdd (its backing file was not located) resting on a VERIFIED fact about /dev/sdf.
new_precision_found.implication_for_the_blocking_input: The missing input is storage not backed by the same host volume - external media, a second physical disk, or a network target - not merely root privilege to run mount.

results.result: /var/run/docker.sock absent. All 33 Docker Desktop sockets under shared-sockets are root:root and connect() returns EACCES for uid 1000 (the guest-services sockets are srwxr-xr-x, so 'others' lack write permission, which connect() requires). The docker CLI on PATH is the Windows binary and reports the distro has no Docker integration. sudo -n exits 1 ('interactive authentication is required'). podman, skopeo, umoci, buildah, nerdctl are all absent and apt-get requires root. newuidmap and newgidmap do NOT exist, so rootless podman/buildah could not be made to work even if installed.
results.conclusion: No container runtime is obtainable in this distro without operator action. Confirms the prior record independently.
